faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.creditQuestion: What is a credit and how is it used?
faq.creditAnswer: A credit is used to generate one video. Each video generation consumes 1 credit, regardless of video length or complexity. Failed generations are automatically refunded.
faq.rolloverAnswer: Unused credits roll over to the next month, up to the maximum rollover limit for your tier (Free: 10, Pro: 50, Premium: unlimited). Credits expire after 6 months of inactivity.
faq.changeQuestion: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faq.changeAnswer: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your plan at any time. When downgrading, you keep access to your current plan features until the end of your billing cycle.
faq.teamAnswer: Team plans with shared credits and collaborative features are available for Premium tier subscribers. Contact us for custom pricing.
